# Apartmani Igalo Monako

> Family-run apartments in Igalo, Herceg Novi, Montenegro, welcoming guests since 2000 — 100 m from the beach and the Igalo Institute. Seasonal holiday rentals and all-inclusive monthly rentals (Sept–June), rented directly by the owner. Address: Dubrovačka 1, Igalo 85347, Montenegro. Contact: hotel-monako@hotmail.com, +382 67 558 240.

Site content is in Serbian (Latin script) with selected pages available in English.
